note:
Multiplicative Weights Update Algorithm (MWUA) exponentially increases weight choices for sampling events. So:
  _ {t+1} = w_t \cdot (1 + G)$
in the case of a positive event. I think this is effectively EXP3 for the multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem. This can be used in a variety of other contexts and gives some theoretical guarantees about convergence, regret minimization and optimality, under certain conditions.
The more general method is called mirror descent.
